title: AlertSchedulingInfo
description: How one alert is scheduled right now: its job, its trigger, how far it has read and what the last reconcile found. It answers why an alert is not firing in one request.

enabled.description: Whether the stored alert is enabled. A disabled alert has no job.

jobClass.description: Class the job is stored with. Absent when the alert has no job.

triggerState.description: State of the alert's own trigger in the job store, such as NORMAL, BLOCKED or ERROR. NONE when it has no trigger.

currentOffset.description: The position the alert has read up to.

latestOffset.description: The offset of the newest change event.

lag.description: Change events the alert has not read yet.

lastReconcileAt.description: When a reconcile on the answering server last looked at this alert.

lastReconcileVerdict.description: What that reconcile found: healthy, or what it repaired.
